criteria.requirement: Add Component.from_ical_strict(st, multiple=False), inherited by Calendar and LazyCalendar, as an explicit strict component-boundary parsing API. Before constructing any parser/model or caching any timezone, inspect all unfolded BEGIN/END markers with a textual stack: reject orphan END, case-insensitive name mismatch, cross-layer closure, and unfinished BEGIN at EOF. Include actual and expected names in mismatch errors. Accept str, bytes and Path (read once), valid nested and unknown X components, and preserve the multiple return contract plus subclass parser dispatch. Use a shared private ComponentIcalParser boundary validator and then the existing cls.from_ical path. This checks structural component boundaries, not every RFC property. Preserve the original from_ical signature and permissive behavior, all frozen tests, custom factories and lazy parsing; do not hardcode old malformed fixtures or make strictness the default.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
